Dear Sir/Ma’am,  
 
Sub:Intimation of Earnings Conference Call Invite to discuss operational and financial 
performance of the Company for the quarter ended 30th June 2026.  
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Part A of Schedule III of the Securities and Exchange 
Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we 
hereby inform that post announcement of the financial results for the quarter ended 30th June, 
2026, the Company will host an Earnings Conference Call with Analysts/Investors to discuss 
the financial and operational performance of the Company for the quarter ended 30th June, 2026 
on Wednesday, 5th August 2026 at 10:00 AM (IST). 
 
During the aforesaid earning call, no price sensitive information will be disclosed or discussed.  
 
Schedule of Earning call is enclosed. The above schedule may undergo a change due to 
exigencies on the part of the Host / the Company.  
 
Kindly take the same on records.
